units.title: Greeting delivery guidance
units.text: Deliver the greeting in your own words and keep it short.
units.source_span: Greeting. Say this in your own words, and keep it short.

units.title: Sample greeting wording
units.text: Sample greeting (may be said in your own words): Thanks for calling Harbor Health Member Services. My name is [first name]. I see you are calling about a prescription question on your Medicare Advantage plan. This call may be monitored or recorded. How can I help you today?
units.source_span: Thanks for calling Harbor Health Member Services. My name is [first name]. I see you are calling about a prescription question on your Medicare Advantage plan. This call may be monitored or recorded. How can I help you today?

units.title: Use IVR-captured drug name
units.text: If the IVR already captured the drug name, do not make the member retell the whole story. Confirm the drug and the pharmacy, then move on.
units.source_span: Advocate note: If the IVR already captured the drug name, do not make the member retell the whole story. Confirm the drug and the pharmacy, then move on.

units.title: Member verification requirement
units.text: Verify the member with two of these: member ID, date of birth, or the address on file.
units.source_span: Verify the member with two of these: member ID, date of birth, or the address on file.

units.title: Caregiver authorization check
units.text: If a caregiver is on the line, check the authorization on the account before you talk about the drug or the price.
units.source_span: If a caregiver is on the line, check the authorization on the account before you talk about the drug or the price.

units.title: Callback when verification fails
units.text: If you cannot verify the caller, offer to call the member back.
units.source_span: If you cannot verify, offer to call the member back.

units.title: No coverage details to unverified callers
units.text: Do not quote a copay, a tier, or a coverage limit to an unverified caller, and do not say whether a drug is on the formulary.
units.source_span: Do not quote a copay, a tier, or a coverage limit to an unverified caller, and do not say whether a drug is on the formulary.

units.title: Read pricing disclaimer before any dollar amount
units.text: Before you say any dollar amount, read the pricing disclaimer word for word. Do not shorten it.
units.source_span: Before you say any dollar amount, read the next block word for word. Do not shorten it.

units.title: Pricing estimate disclaimer (Legal)
units.text: The price I quote is an estimate for a 30-day supply at a preferred retail pharmacy, based on the plan records I can see today. Your actual cost can change if the pharmacy, the days' supply, or your stage of coverage is different. This estimate is not a guarantee of payment.
units.source_span: The price I quote is an estimate for a 30-day supply at a preferred retail pharmacy, based on the plan records I can see today. Your actual cost can change if the pharmacy, the days' supply, or your stage of coverage is different. This estimate is not a guarantee of payment.

units.title: Answering "is that my copay?"
units.text: Members often ask "is that my copay?" after the pricing disclaimer. You may say the estimate reflects the copay or coinsurance on the plan record.
units.source_span: Advocate note: Members often ask "is that my copay?" after this line. You may say the estimate reflects the copay or coinsurance on the plan record.

units.title: Do not promise pharmacy charge
units.text: You may not promise that the pharmacy will charge the estimated amount.
units.source_span: You may not promise that the pharmacy will charge that amount.

units.title: 90-day mail-order eligibility for maintenance drugs
units.text: For a maintenance drug, offer a 90-day mail-order supply only after the member has filled that same drug at a retail pharmacy two times in the current calendar year.
units.source_span: For a maintenance drug, offer a 90-day mail-order supply only after the member has filled that same drug at a retail pharmacy two times in the current calendar year.

units.title: Specialty drugs not converted to mail order
units.text: Specialty drugs stay at Harbor Specialty Pharmacy and are not converted to mail order on this call.
units.source_span: Specialty drugs stay at Harbor Specialty Pharmacy and are not converted to mail order on this call.

units.title: Read closing word for word, then stop
units.text: Read the two closing sentences word for word, then stop.
units.source_span: Read the next two sentences word for word, then stop.

units.title: Closing statement (Legal)
units.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today? Thank you for calling Harbor Health. We appreciate you trusting us with your coverage.
units.source_span: Is there anything else I can help you with today? Thank you for calling Harbor Health. We appreciate you trusting us with your coverage.

units.title: Optional portal summary mention
units.text: You may add, in your own words, that a summary of this call will appear in the member portal within two business days.
units.source_span: You may add, in your own words, that a summary of this call will appear in the member portal within two business days.

units.title: No price, tier, or network statements after closing
units.text: Do not add any price, tier, or network statement after the closing verbatim.
units.source_span: Do not add any price, tier, or network statement after the closing verbatim.
